rows.reconciliation: page 63, the row `GRAND TOTAL`: amount 29,744,547.31 vs printed 29,744,547.31
rows.proof: `FY 2013 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2013`, PDF page 63 of the FY2013 annual town report (printed page 59). THE PAGE IS LANDSCAPE and carries NO TEXT LAYER, so it was rotated upright and read off its own 400 dpi bitmap, never recognised. IT IS LAID OUT AS THREE LABEL/AMOUNT COLUMN-PAIRS read left to right, so the printed reading order is down one pair and then down the next -- a section heading can therefore be at the foot of one pair with its last line at the head of the next. THE BLOCK HEADED `SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS`, nine categories against a printed `GRAND TOTAL`. THE CHECK: the nine categories sum to 29,744,547.31, the printed GRAND TOTAL, EXACTLY to the cent. `NON RECURRING  REVENUE` is transcribed with the double space the page prints. THE SUMMARY IS A RECLASSIFICATION of the receipts listed in detail elsewhere on the same page, and the page does NOT print which detail line belongs to which category. Three of the nine are recoverable because the detail carries the same heading and foots exactly to the summary line -- LICENSES AND PERMITS, STATE REVENUE and FINES & FORFEITS, each in its own file. The other six are not, and no mapping is asserted for them.

rows.reconciliation: 62 of 62 rows carry exactly 1 figures
rows.proof: `FY 2013 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2013`, PDF page 63 of the FY2013 annual town report (printed page 59): THE DETAIL LINES THAT ARE NOT ALREADY IN A BLOCK THAT FOOTS TO A SUMMARY LINE. The page is LANDSCAPE, carries NO TEXT LAYER, and is laid out as THREE LABEL/AMOUNT COLUMN-PAIRS read left to right, so a section heading can sit at the foot of one pair with its last line at the head of the next. It was rotated upright and read off its own 400 dpi bitmap, never recognised. Each line's printed section heading is carried in `fund_number`, verbatim and with its colon; where the page prints NO heading above a block that is said so, rather than a heading being supplied. THE DECLARED CHECK IS `cells_per_row` = 1: every printed line carries exactly one amount. THAT PROVES THE SHAPE AND NOT THE DIGITS, and it is weaker than arithmetic, which this block of lines has none of -- the page prints no total over them. WHAT DOES BEAR ON THE DIGITS. The page prints 91 detail lines in all. Three of its printed blocks foot EXACTLY to the matching line of its own SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS and are filed separately and proven: LICENSES/PERMITS to 174,193.45, STATE REVENUE to 7,010,803.56 and FINES & FORFEITS to 27,405.00 (that last only once DOG FINES, printed in the next column-pair under no heading, is included -- without it the block makes 24,555.00). The nine summary categories themselves foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL of 29,744,547.31 exactly. Four exact closes across 29 lines is what says this reading is sound. AND THE RESIDUAL, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN. The 62 lines in THIS file sum to 22,531,545.30, and with the three blocks filed separately all 91 detail lines sum to 29,743,947.31, which is $600.00 BELOW the printed GRAND TOTAL of 29,744,547.31. Every figure was re-read at 400 dpi in a second, tighter crop and no misread was found; the three blocks that close to the cent bound the error away from 29 of the 91 lines. WHETHER THE DETAIL IS MEANT TO BE EXHAUSTIVE OF THE SUMMARY IS NOT STATED BY THE PAGE, so the $600.00 is NOT recorded as the town's arithmetic failing -- that would be attesting an identity the document does not assert. It is recorded here as what it is: a 600.00 difference between two printings on one page that we cannot resolve from this page. ONE MORE OBSERVATION, OFFERED AND NOT ASSERTED. The six lines printed under NO heading between STATE REVENUE and FINES & FORFEITS include five -- TRAILER PARKS, both MEADOW WOODS WATER lines and both STREET BETTERMENT lines -- that sum to 64,594.41, exactly the summary's SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS; RESCUE WAGON, printed in the middle of them, does not belong to that sum. The page prints no heading there, so nothing here establishes the grouping and none is recorded.

rows.read_by: claude-opus-5, read off each page's OWN STORED BITMAP (pypdf, one CCITT-G4 image a page, 4400x3400 at 518 dpi) rotated 90 degrees upright and cropped in halves; NO recognition was used
rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2013`, PDF pages 65-70 of the FY2013 annual town report (4119-fy-2013-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 61-66 -- the Town Accountant's schedule. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `PROGRAM NAME` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE` | `TOTAL EXPENDED` | `TOTAL ENCUMBERED` | `BALANCE TO REVENUE`, repeated verbatim at the top of all six pages. That settles FY2013 pp.67-68, which HANDOFF-ANNUAL-REPORTS next-step 2 names as one of four places where column names could not be established by inference: the names were never degraded, they were simply never read, and they are the same six FY2014, FY2017 and FY2018 print. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns fewer than 6 words on all 97 pages, tested per page -- so the schedule was read off the pages' own 518 dpi bitmaps. No recognition was used and the OCR cache is not a starting point: it misses 7 of the 17 `fwd` marker lines outright. A `fwd` MARKER IS A LINE OF THE APPROPRIATED FORWARD COLUMN, NOT AN ANNOTATION -- the page's own legend at the foot of p70 reads `fwd - forward from FY 2012` -- and every department's printed subtotal includes its forward line. WHAT PROVES THE WHOLE TABLE, and it is three independent things: (1) the 83 department lines sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL on p70 in ALL FIVE columns, EXACTLY -- 29,862,537.75 / 29,862,537.75 / 29,616,931.60 / 211,530.04 / 34,076.11, no tolerance declared and none needed; (2) every one of the 79 department lines that prints a BALANCE TO REVENUE satisfies the identity the page states in its own headings, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE less TOTAL EXPENDED less TOTAL ENCUMBERED, to the cent, 0 failures -- the other 4 print no balance and assert nothing; (3) the 133 LINE ITEMS foot to their own department's printed subtotal in every column that department prints, across the 54 departments that print detail, 0 failures. A fourth regularity the page keeps everywhere and which nothing here rests on: APPROPRIATED FORWARD equals TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE on all 83 department lines and on the GRAND TOTAL. NOT ESTABLISHED, and it is rule 11's territory: these are NET general-fund appropriations. Grants, circuit breaker, school choice and revolving funds pay for real staff and appear nowhere on these six pages, so a line rising is not a department growing.

rows.reconciliation: page 70, the row `fwd - forward from FY 2012`: appropriated_forward 130,872.5 vs printed 160,872.5
rows.proof: The `fwd` FORWARD LINES of the FY2013 GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS schedule, PDF pages 65-70 of the FY2013 annual town report, against the memo line the schedule prints at the foot of p70: `fwd - forward from FY 2012  $160,872.50`. EVERY FORWARD MARKER ON ALL SIX PAGES WAS READ, by cropping the APPROPRIATED FORWARD column full height on each of the six pages and looking at it -- 17 markers, summing to $130,872.50, which is $30,000.00 BELOW the memo. WHAT THE MEMO IS, established across documents and not inferred: it is the PRIOR YEAR'S TOTAL ENCUMBRANCE. The FY2012 annual town report prints, on its PDF page 65, `GRAND TOTAL ... $28,395,610.46  $28,395,610.46  $28,063,432.58  $160,872.50  $171,305.38` -- its TOTAL ENCUMBERED column is $160,872.50, the FY2013 memo to the cent, read off the FY2012 page's own 518 dpi bitmap and not off recognition. The mechanism is visible line by line on that same page: FY2012 encumbers $1,995.00 against `Physicals` and $2,154.45 against `Liability Insurance`, and those are exactly the two forward markers FY2013 prints for Physicals and Liability Insurance. SO THE MEMO IS NOT WRONG AND THE READ IS NOT SHORT. What is true is that the FY2013 schedule prints markers for only $130,872.50 of the $160,872.50 it carried forward, and WHICH DEPARTMENT RECEIVED THE REMAINING $30,000.00 IS NOT RECOVERABLE FROM THESE SIX PAGES. THE READ DOES NOT DEPEND ON ANY OF THIS: the 17 forward amounts are already inside the department subtotals that foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL in all five columns to the cent, and the unmarked $30,000 is inside them too -- APPROPRIATED FORWARD ties exactly -- so it is the ATTRIBUTION that is missing, not the money. The $30,000 is recorded as `attested` so the verifier REPORTS it on every run rather than hiding it in a tolerance; it is not a widened tolerance and no digit was chosen to make anything close. SIBLING ROW: `money-gaps.csv` already carries the same question for FY2017, where the schedule's own APPROPRIATED FORWARD column was $362.00 SHORT of its printed GRAND TOTAL. FY2013's column is not short, so that diagnosis does not transfer -- here the total is right and only the marker is absent.
